items.title: 9.6.3 Developing Communication and Storytelling Skills (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.6.3 (PDF 220-221), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Communication aur storytelling ki skills behtar karne ke liye kuch mashware:

items: Regular mashq (Practice Regularly): aap jitna zyada bolenge aur kahaniyan sunayenge, utna zyada confidence (aitmaad) aayega.
Sunne walon ko jaanein (Know Your Audience): apna paigham un logon ke mutabiq dhalein jin se baat kar rahe hain, chahe woh classmates hon, teachers hon ya ghar wale.
Visual Aids istemal karein (dekhne wali madadgar cheezein): tasveerein, diagrams aur props (cheezein jo dikha kar samjhaya jaye) kahani ko dilchasp aur aasan banate hain.
Saaf aur mukhtasar (Clear and Concise): ghair zaroori tafseel se bachein aur asal paigham par tawajjo rakhein.

Jazbat dikhayein (Show Emotion): apni awaz aur chehre ke taasurat se dikhayein ke aap topic ke bare mein kya mehsoos karte hain. Is se aap ki baat zyada sachchi (authentic) aur dil ko lagne wali banti hai.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Classmates ke saath daire (circle) mein baith jayein. Har shakhs baari baari kahani ka ek hissa sunaye. Pehla shakhs shuruaati jumla bolta hai, aur har agla shakhs kahani mein kuch jorta hai yahan tak ke kahani mukammal ho jaye. Is activity se storytelling ki mashq hoti hai aur doosron ke khayalat par aage baat barhana aata hai.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Kya aap jante hain ke history (tareekh) ki sab se taqatwar speeches (taqreeron) mein se ek, Martin Luther King Jr. ki "I Have a Dream" speech, sirf apne paigham ki wajah se nahi balke is wajah se bhi ke woh kis andaaz se boli gayi yaad ki jati hai? Storytelling, jazbat aur saaf communication ke mel ne use unforgettable (kabhi na bhoolne wali) bana diya.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke is box mein kisi aur jagah ka ek jumla toot kar chhap gaya hai: "Think of this phase like design…ing a new house. You need blueprints to show where the rooms and furniture will go before you start building." (naye ghar ke naqshe wali baat). Is ka is box se koi taluq nahi. Box ka asal paigham sirf Martin Luther King Jr. ki speech wali baat hai, jaisa oopar likha hai.

blocks.prompt: Brand banane aur customers se jurne mein communication aur storytelling ka kirdar bataiye (long question 7).
blocks.explanation: Saaf communication customers ko batati hai ke brand kya deta hai, aur un ki raye sunti hai; is se bharosa banta hai. Storytelling brand ko ek personality (shakhsiyat) aur jazbati matlab deti hai, jaise founder (karobar shuru karne wale) ka safar ya kisi customer ki kamyabi ki kahani, is liye log brand ko yaad rakhte aur us se jura hua mehsoos karte hain. Ishtiharat, social media aur customer service mein in skills ka istemal aam khareedaron ko loyal (wafadar) customers bana deta hai jo doosron ko bhi brand ka mashwara dete hain.

items: Behtari ke tareeqe: mashq, audience ko jaanna, visual aids, saaf aur mukhtasar baat, jazbat.
